payload.title: Prepare factual LeftBlock Papyrus and Anth.us drafts for review
payload.description: Prepare later factual draft material for the Papyrus site and Anth.us describing LeftBlock, its Data Parade home, the shift-left inspection flow, verified detection evidence, limitations, and compatibility. Coordinate active Papyrus/Claude ownership and use the Ryan-approved logo when available. Distinguish verified release/install facts from pending work; no claims of perfect protection or completed rollout. This task authorizes preparation for review only: do not publish, deploy, schedule a post, or send promotional messages. Separate publication approval is required after review.
